title: Live Full List keeps its scroll position when the Waiting for music banner appears
acceptance: On iPhone Safari in Live › Full List, scrolled down to a later track, a jump that brings up the Waiting for music banner leaves the list where it was (or scrolls to the current track), never back to the top.
The same holds when the banner goes away again, and for Start, Next, Previous and a timeline tap.
A LiveMode test covers the banner appearing while the Full List is scrolled and fails before the fix.
nextAction: Owner-requested (2026-11-07, Air session) from the owner's iPhone Safari recording of production f55b449a. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Start in apps/web/src/components/LiveMode.tsx: find why the banner's insertion above the Full List resets its scroll (remount, a key change, or the scroll container's content shifting). Whether the banner should show for a normal 2-4 s start is a separate question, not this task.

evidence.summary: Owner's iPhone Safari screen recording (12:37, production f55b449a, Apple Music, class Limp Bizkit Essentials), kept by the owner, not in the repo: Full List scrolled to tracks 12-15, the owner tapped row 13; the clock jumped to 50:44 and about 2 s later Waiting for music appeared and the list was back at the top (Track 13 of 15, rows 1-2 showing). Music started about 2 s after that. Earlier row jumps to 6 and 9, which showed no banner, kept the scroll position.
